dct_title_s: Map of the survey of sundary house lots laid out in the city of Albany for and pursuant to the instructions of the Dutch Church of Albany : all lots in the above survey are thirty three feet wide in front and rear and one hundred and sixty feet deep, except such as have their measures expressed on the map : those along the Schenectady Turnpike are laid out at right angles thereto, and those on Deer Street at right angles to that street
